import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    order_items = db["order_items"]
    # Только позиции заказов, купленные строго до seed_time
    oi = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()

    # Только отзывы, которые уже опубликованы на момент seed_time
    rev = db["reviews"]
    rev = rev[rev["review_answer_timestamp"] < seed_time].copy()

    # Платежи по заказам, купленным до seed_time
    pay = db["payments"]
    pay = pay[pay["ts"] < seed_time].copy()

    # Заказы, доставка которых завершена до seed_time
    orders = db["orders"]
    delivered = orders[
        (orders["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna())
        & (orders["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)
        & (orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time)
    ][["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp", "order_delivered_customer_date"]].copy()
    delivered["delivery_days"] = (
        delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"]
        - delivered["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
    delivered = delivered[delivered["delivery_days"] >= 0]

    # --- базовые агрегаты по продукту ---
    prod = oi.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units=("order_id", "count"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        n_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        n_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        first_sale=("ts", "min"),
        last_sale=("ts", "max"),
    )
    prod["product_age_days"] = (seed_time - prod["first_sale"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
    prod["last_sale_days"] = (seed_time - prod["last_sale"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
    prod["avg_units_per_order"] = prod["total_units"] / prod["n_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)

    # --- окна: 30 / 90 / 180 / 365 дней ---
    for days in (30, 90, 180, 365):
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
        w = oi[oi["ts"] >= cutoff].groupby("product_id").agg(
            units=("order_id", "count"),
            revenue=("price", "sum"),
            orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            rev_per_order=("price", "mean"),
        )
        prod[f"units_{days}d"] = w["units"].reindex(prod.index).fillna(0)
        prod[f"revenue_{days}d"] = w["revenue"].reindex(prod.index).fillna(0)
        prod[f"orders_{days}d"] = w["orders"].reindex(prod.index).fillna(0)
        prod[f"rev_per_order_{days}d"] = w["rev_per_order"].reindex(prod.index)

    # тренды
    prod["trend_30_90"] = prod["units_30d"] - prod["units_90d"]
    prod["trend_ratio_30_90"] = prod["units_30d"] / (prod["trend_30_90"] + 1.0)
    prod["trend_90_365"] = prod["units_90d"] / (prod["units_365d"] + 1.0)
    prod["revenue_trend_30_90"] = prod["revenue_30d"] - prod["revenue_90d"]

    # интервалы между продажами за последний год
    last_year = oi[oi["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=365)]
    gaps = (
        last_year.sort_values("ts").groupby("product_id")["ts"].apply(
            lambda x: x.diff().dt.total_seconds().dropna() / 86400.0
        )
    )
    gap_stats = gaps.groupby(level=0).agg(gap_mean="mean", gap_max="max", gap_std="std")
    prod = prod.join(gap_stats, how="left")

    if "gap_mean" in prod.columns:
        prod["recency_vs_gap"] = prod["last_sale_days"] / (prod["gap_mean"] + 1.0)

    # --- отзывы (только существующие на seed_time, привязка к заказам до seed_time) ---
    oi_pid = oi[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates("order_id")
    rev_prod = rev.merge(oi_pid, on="order_id", how="inner")
    rev_prod = rev_prod[rev_prod["review_answer_timestamp"] < seed_time]
    rstats = rev_prod.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("review_id", "count"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
        n_neg_reviews=("review_score", lambda x: (x <= 2).sum()),
        n_pos_reviews=("review_score", lambda x: (x >= 4).sum()),
        days_since_last_review=(
            "review_answer_timestamp",
            lambda x: (seed_time - x.max()).total_seconds() / 86400.0,
        ),
    )
    rstats["pct_negative_reviews"] = (
        rstats["n_neg_reviews"] / rstats["total_reviews"].replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    rstats["pct_positive_reviews"] = (
        rstats["n_pos_reviews"] / rstats["total_reviews"].replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    rev_y = rev_prod[
        rev_prod["review_answer_timestamp"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=365)
    ]
    rstats["reviews_365d"] = rev_y.groupby("product_id")["review_id"].count()
    rstats["avg_score_365d"] = rev_y.groupby("product_id")["review_score"].mean()

    prod = prod.join(rstats.drop(columns=["n_neg_reviews", "n_pos_reviews"]), how="left")

    # --- платежи по заказам до seed_time ---
    pay_prod = pay.merge(oi_pid, on="order_id", how="inner")
    pstats = pay_prod.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_payment=("payment_value", "mean"),
        total_paid=("payment_value", "sum"),
        max_installments=("payment_installments", "max"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
    )
    prod = prod.join(pstats, how="left")

    # --- скорость доставки (только доставленные до seed_time) ---
    del_prod = delivered.merge(oi_pid, on="order_id", how="inner")
    dstats = del_prod.groupby("product_id")["delivery_days"].agg(
        avg_delivery_days="mean", max_delivery_days="max"
    )
    prod = prod.join(dstats, how="left")

    # --- обработка пропусков ---
    fill_zero = [
        "total_units", "total_revenue", "n_orders", "n_sellers",
        "units_30d", "units_90d", "units_180d", "units_365d",
        "revenue_30d", "revenue_90d", "revenue_180d", "revenue_365d",
        "orders_30d", "orders_90d", "orders_180d", "orders_365d",
        "total_reviews", "reviews_365d",
    ]
    for c in fill_zero:
        if c in prod.columns:
            prod[c] = prod[c].fillna(0)

    for c, v in (
        ("last_sale_days", 3650.0),
        ("days_since_last_review", 3650.0),
        ("gap_max", 3650.0),
        ("recency_vs_gap", 365.0),
    ):
        if c in prod.columns:
            prod[c] = prod[c].fillna(v)

    for c in prod.columns:
        if not np.issubdtype(prod[c].dtype, np.number):
            prod[c] = pd.to_numeric(prod[c], errors="coerce")
        if prod[c].isna().all():
            prod[c] = prod[c].fillna(0)
        else:
            prod[c] = prod[c].fillna(prod[c].median())

    prod = prod.drop(columns=[c for c in ("first_sale", "last_sale") if c in prod.columns])

    result = prod.reindex(entity_ids)
    result = result.fillna(0).astype("float64")
    result.index.name = "product_id"
    return result
